The file tests the orchestrate Claude relay's "no accounts start" failure path; the variable `isolation_timeout` is referenced in the relay loop fragment (clarify_isolated_run.sh:24,201) extracted by the test, and `set -euo pipefail` in the test's `bash -c` invocation makes the reference unbound under the test fixture. The fix itself is technically correct (sets the variable to its empty default), but the change is unrelated to the conflict resolver path admission that #6596 is fixing and has no plausible reactive trigger — the resolver and this test do not share code paths. Per CLAUDE.md §12.A/E, an out-of-scope proactive fix discovered during review must land in the same PR but in its own commit, with the PR description enumerating it under a "Proactive fixes included" subsection; the PR description here has no such entry, and `git log -1 --format=%s` shows one commit titled "AI implementation for issue #6596" — the scope creep and missing proactive-fix attribution are the defects.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
